changes.title: Electron shell and native identity
changes.upstreamDependency: The shell mounts the unmodified official Web profile from the packaged runtime closure.
changes.updateRule: Keep native window behavior in the product shell and rebuild the complete official runtime plus frontend overlay before packaging.

changes.title: Desktop chrome and outer frame
changes.upstreamDependency: The indexed frontend files are copied over the locked official Web entry only in a disposable build worktree.
changes.updateRule: Regenerate the frontend overlay against the lock and require every indexed hash to match before building.

changes.title: Composer, file drag, message actions, and model settings
changes.upstreamDependency: The product frontend is compiled together with the official client module table and Host contracts.
changes.updateRule: Keep presentation changes in the indexed frontend overlay; never edit the pinned upstream worktree during a port.

changes.title: Sidebar policy and Codex-like layout
changes.upstreamDependency: The indexed layout files replace only the corresponding presentation files in the temporary source tree.
changes.updateRule: A changed upstream layout surface must fail hash validation and be ported explicitly.

changes.title: Durable file attachment and RPC contracts
changes.upstreamDependency: Model-visible files and durable session data use the official Host/API implementation.
changes.updateRule: Keep the backend source plane empty; update the upstream lock and rebuild the official runtime when upstream changes.

changes.title: Profile composition and provider behavior
changes.upstreamDependency: The product mounts the official profile layers from the locked upstream runtime.
changes.updateRule: Do not hand-edit or overlay the official profile; update the upstream lock and rerun the complete source and runtime checks.

changes.title: Electron preload bridge and cross-face contracts
changes.upstreamDependency: Renderer and Electron main communicate through the product-owned typed bridge.
changes.updateRule: Version bridge changes with the product release and build Host, Client, and desktop faces together.

changes.title: Clean upstream composition, Git lock, and artifact retention
changes.upstreamDependency: A release is the locked pair of product Git tree and official upstream Git commit plus the indexed frontend files.
changes.updateRule: A lock mismatch, dirty upstream tree, missing source input, unsupported backend overlay, or artifact hash mismatch stops the release.
